lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: The window's smashed. Cold air, and that orange buzz from the streetlamp.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Wait. There's barely any glass in here. Most of it is out on the porch.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: If someone broke in, the glass should have fallen inside. I'm keeping a piece.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Glass on the porch, not the carpet. Whoever broke this was standing in our living room.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Not yet. I have the pieces. Now I need to make them fit.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [The deduction board that opens this door arrives in Milestone 2.]

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: The deadbolt's open. I check the lock: no scratches, no pry marks.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Somebody unlocked this. They didn't break it.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: I'm not leaving until I understand what happened here.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Not a mark on the lock. I'm not leaving until I understand what happened here.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Three hooks. Mom's keys, my keys, and the spare.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: The spare's hook is empty. Just its little brass tag, lying on the floor.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Whoever took the spare knew exactly where we keep it.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Our photo from the lake. The glass is cracked straight down the middle.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Everything else got thrown around. This was laid face-down. Gently. Like someone didn't want it watching.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: The crack runs right between me and Mom.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Every book pulled off the shelf, spines cracked open.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Like someone was hunting for something hidden between the pages. Or wanted it to look that way.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Mom's books. I'll put them back later. If there is a later.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Cushions slashed open. Stuffing everywhere.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: There's a dark gap underneath. I can't see a thing down there.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Whoever did this was angry. Or putting on a show.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Just dust and a pen I lost in ninth grade.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Nothing else under there. Nothing I can see, anyway.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Pitch black under there. I've got the flashlight. I should use it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Open the Inventory (I), choose the Flashlight, then click here.]

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Too dark to see anything under there. I need a light. There's one in the kitchen, if they didn't take it.
